reason: The plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is a web-based local SKILL browser: it discovers SKILL markdown files from configured local paths, watches for file changes, and displays them in a Settings UI with an invocation helper, as documented in the README and plugin manifest.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DSH 网页设置中提供本地 SKILL 浏览功能，可扫描并实时更新本地技能文件列表，并给出每个技能的使用说明。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a local SKILL browser in the DSH web Settings UI that scans configured local directories, updates the list in real time, and shows how to invoke each skill.

capabilities: Discover local skill definitions from configured directories
Watch local skill directories for add/modify/delete changes
Render discovered skills in a web Settings panel
Provide per-skill usage guidance and copy-ready prompts

reasons.code: README states the plugin scans local directories for SKILL.md and <name>.md files and supports configurable skillDirs.
README states chokidar is used to watch file changes and refresh models/UI on updates.
README describes a web Settings page in the plugin UI listing all available skills with description and scenario.
Package metadata identifies a host entry (lib/index.js) and a web client entry (lib/client.js), indicating split runtime behavior across app profiles.
